Trigger A creature from a family in your selected Monster Affinity category uses a manipulate action, uses a move action, or leaves a square during a move action it’s using

Requirements The triggering creature is within the reach or the first range increment of an anima weapon or a spell that requires an Anima Strike.

The affinity of certain creatures triggers you and your twin’s heightened reflexes in combat, striking them to prevent their escape. Make a melee Strike or Cast an anima spell which requires an Anima Strike against the triggering creature. Casting a spell in this way does not trigger reactions from the triggering creature.

Symbiosis Your souls @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.NGV2AemOug2Rj21M]{Effect: Harmonized} if the attack is a critical hit.
